title: SETU Food: four promises, proven on the real app (customer walkthrough)
angle: VALUE-FIRST. Open on the owner's line, then let the app state what makes SETU different in its own words: the real desktop sign-in panel ('The campus, and only the campus.', 'no wallet, no commission, no middle layer', stats DELIVERY Campus only / COMMISSION None / PAYMENT Direct) plus 'Approved sellers'. Those words lift off the real screen into a four-chip promise system (DELIVERY Campus only, SELLERS Approved, COMMISSION None, PAYMENT Direct) that collapses into a 4-dot indicator by the chapter label. The customer journey then runs in the owner's order (sign-in with OTP demo, new account, location, discover, cart, payment, tracking, review) and each promise gets an orange PROVEN stamp on the exact real screen that proves it: Campus only at 'Location is within the IIT Kharagpur delivery area.', Approved at 'Approved by SETU · you pay the seller directly', No commission at the cart's 'Item total + Seller delivery charge = Payable to seller', Direct at 'SETU does not collect this.' Captions carry a 212-word narration at about 2.3 words/s; the end card has no narration so the verbatim disclaimer gets 6 s of clean reading time. Total 113.8 s.
